prompt_text:
Match this appearance phrase against ALL anonymous person tiles in the image(s): "the person with long dark hair in a low ponytail wearing a black leotard with a sheer mesh overlay and a flared skirt"
Every labeled tile is one different person from the same video; its two crops are held-out views. Labels and tile order do not reveal the intended target. A phrase may match none, one, or several people. Include ALL people who visibly satisfy the whole phrase in matches. Include in uncertain any plausible person for whom the views do not resolve an attribute, instead of assuming that person is a non-match. Do not pick a best match when several fit. A location or action does not distinguish appearance. Omitted labels mean clear non-matches.
Return {"matches":["P01"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"brief visual explanation"}. Valid labels: ["P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P08"].

message.content: {"matches":["P04"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"Only P04 clearly shows long dark hair in a low ponytail and a black leotard with a sheer mesh overlay and flared skirt. Other individuals (e.g., P01, P02, P03, P05, P07, P08) have similar outfits but their hair is either lighter, shorter, or styled differently (e.g., buns, high ponytails). P06 is not clearly visible enough to confirm all attributes. P04’s multiple views consistently show the described appearance."}
